steps.content:
23:04, July 23, N.F. 113
Shalom's Home, Erica Villa, Eastside
Inside the bedroom, Shalom opens her eyes and gets up slowly. The bandages on her have all been unwound, strewn across the bed. But all her wounds are gone as well.
Body repair always consumes a lot of stamina. Shalom feels exhausted. She rings the bell.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Yes... Understood. I've just repaired my body. I've spent too much energy on it.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: ...Yes, understood. I'll get going soon.
Outside the window wall, the Blue Rain shrouds the entire Erica Villa, falling incessantly. The person she's waiting for is not here yet.

steps.speaker: I... I...
steps.content: Ah—!!
With a woman's scream from downstairs, the door opens.

steps.speaker: Maid
steps.content: M-miss Shalom. Your clothes...

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Thank you.

The maid enters to help Shalom dress. She dares not close the door, but the voice keeps creeping in from downstairs, alternating among cries, curses, and hysterical laughs, reminding her of how that severe Liaison Officer from Paradeisos is interrogating the poor assassin.

Since that Liaison Officer entered the house, everything has felt different. The maid shivers uncontrollably, her fingers brushing against her employer's skin. Shalom can feel the fear underneath the icy cold.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Are you scared of me? Because I'm from Paradeisos too?

steps.speaker: Maid
steps.content: No-no. That's your private matter. Whoever you are, whatever you do, it's not my place to judge...

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You seem to really need this job. Don't worry, I'm not going to fire you.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I adore this mansion and your company. You've been doing an excellent job. You should stay. These frightening scenes, just pretend they're a nightmare. Take a few days off and come back to work when you feel better.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Take care of my garden, Rosa. I hope the day I return, I'll find that nothing's changed here.

steps.speaker: Maid
steps.content: Miss Shalom... I...

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Alright, off you go. Or I'll be running late.
Shalom exits her room, goes downstairs, and enters the guarded basement.

steps.speaker: Liaison Officer
steps.content: Set off if you're ready. The car is outside. I'll take over everything here.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: ...Of course.
She glances at Garofano lying on the floor. The assassin is barely even breathing, but her eyes are still full of indignation and determination.
After brief consideration, Shalom begins.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: No need to coerce her further. Rahu will bring back the intelligence.

steps.speaker: Liaison Officer
steps.content: That FAC soldier hasn't been officially recognized yet. Moreover, if she can do that, it's one more reason to kill this worthless assassin. She will be executed here.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: ...She's not worthless.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: The person behind this assassin, not her patron, but her leader, seems to value their members' lives. She'll make excellent bait.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: The questioning may be futile, but her boss is probably willing to meet you and exchange her with some intelligence Paradeisos could use.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I got this piece of information from Rahu too, and it's yours now. Is this reason enough to keep Garofano alive?

steps.speaker: Liaison Officer
steps.content: ...That makes sense. I'll report...!!!
Somehow triggered by one of these sentences, Garofano opens her eyes and shoots an agonized and loathing glare at the two people peering down at her.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I won't let you do that... I won't...
Garofano is clutching a single-eyed rune in her palm. She's gained immense power but also submitted completely to Mania. Filthy spikes protrude all over her body.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: ...So this is the last resort the Underground has granted you, tempting you to go down together with them. How stubborn.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: That's why they can manipulate you so thoroughly.

steps.speaker: Garofano?
steps.content: Keep your hands off them!

steps.speaker: Liaison Officer
steps.content: The Underground's sorcery?! Stand back!
But Shalom doesn't listen. She simply watches as the manic Sinner charges at her again...
A deafening crash draws the sheriffs near the house. As they check with the security chief if they should take a look inside, the front door flies open, and a silhouette bolts out.
With a heavy stench of blood and a chilling vibe, this person dashes into the downpour, vanishing into the pitch-black faster than any normal person could.
Everyone is frozen in shock. The Paradeisos Liaison Officer walks out of the mansion. He's suffered some light injuries but has returned to his usual calm self.

steps.speaker: Liaison Officer
steps.content: A-Class Mania threat. Underground sorcery confirmed. Orders for all combatants on site: Intercept this Sinner. Do not kill her. Capture her alive!
